about: FiveThirtyEight's published presidential forecasts on election day, by unit and model, normalised by pipeline/intake/fte_president_forecasts.py. projected_voteshare is percent of the whole vote as 538 published it; probwin is 538's chance that the candidate wins the unit.

source.name: FiveThirtyEight, checking-our-work-data, presidential_elections.csv (commit f6d5b2e, 2023-02-02)
source.note: 538's published forecasts as kept by 538 for its calibration page; the forecast pages themselves now redirect to ABC News
